category_label_in_summary.root_cause: Step7Summary.tsx has CAT_LABELS with hardcoded keys ('velo', 'raquette', 'fitness' etc). form.category stores the category_id from /tags/categories API. If the API returns category_ids like 'cat_velo' or UUIDs, CAT_LABELS[form.category] returns undefined and falls back to '—'.
category_label_in_summary.reproduction: Navigate to step 9 (Publication) — the summary card shows 'Catégorie: —' instead of the category name.
category_label_in_summary.mitigation: Pass the category label through form state in step 1, or fetch it from the taxonomy context in Step7Summary.
